title: Trick
description: A Trick is this system's spell. See MECHANICS.md section 4 for the authoritative spec. Three tiers: Pledge (at-will), Turn (free, limited by a cooldown), Prestige (OP, spends the caster's class engine). There are deliberately NO spell slots and NO upcasting: a Turn's power is tuned by its cooldown, a Prestige's by its engineCost.

id.description: kebab-case; should match the filename stem.

flavor.description: One or two lines of in-world colour. Kept out of sheetSummary.

tier.description: pledge = at-will cantrip equivalent, no cost and no cooldown. turn = the workhorse; always limited by a cooldown, and MAY also spend engine (full casters only, MECHANICS 4.4a). prestige = the showstopper; spends most of the meter, once per combat, minLevel 5+.

discipline.description: Replaces the 8 standard 5e schools (MECHANICS 4.9). Respects the locked damage-type list: Pyrotechnics = fire, Illusion/Mesmerism = psychic.

minLevel.description: Earliest character level a class may learn this. Prestiges are 5+.

cooldown.description: TURNS ONLY. Rounds the trick is 'Seen' before it can be cast again: you cannot cast it for this many of your turns. Every Turn has one. For a free Turn it is the sole balance dial - a stronger effect gets a longer cooldown; keep it 1-3. A costed Turn is dialled by its engineCost as well.

engineCost.description: How much of the caster's class engine (Phantasm/Mirth/Strings/Clones/Mayhem) this consumes. REQUIRED on a Prestige (price it to eat most of a built-up meter; every Prestige is also capped at once per combat - a tier-wide rule, nothing to set here). OPTIONAL on a Turn, and only for a FULL caster: a costed Turn is the reward for banking the meter, sitting between the free cooldown Turns and the once-per-combat Prestige. Keep a costed Turn well under a Prestige's price. A Pledge may never have one.

components.description: Patter (voice, was Verbal) / Flourish (hands, was Somatic) / Prop (an object, was Material). Prop may carry a parenthetical, e.g. 'Prop (a deck of cards)'.

concentration.description: True if holding this trick requires concentration (MECHANICS 4.13). Set it whenever `duration` says Concentration. A caster holds ONE concentration trick at a time unless a feature says otherwise, and taking damage forces a concentration check.

save.description: Optional. The saving throw a target makes, e.g. 'Wisdom'. Rendered as a chip.

description.description: Player-facing prose. Damage dice use the Scaling Die ([[XdY]] / [[XdY+Abil]]); every derived number is a {{Label|formula}} token - both are build-lint enforced.

narration.description: The IN-PLAY tab: how this looks, sounds, and is performed at the table when it happens mid-fight — the swing, the dodge, the wire going taut, what the crowd sees. Pure fiction, ZERO numbers: never restate a die, a DC, a range, a cost, or a condition name here (those live in the mechanics tab). 2-4 sentences. Written second person, present tense.

sheetSummary.description: Condensed mechanics-only text for the future character sheet: effect, damage + type, conditions, cost/uses. No flavor. Not linted.

options.description: For tricks offering a menu or a random table. Rendered as a table by the shared optionTable renderer.

group.description: Optional grouping label. Rows sharing a label render as their own table under that heading, so effects that always apply are never mixed in with a menu you pick from. Omit it and all rows render as one table, as before.

classes.description: Class ids that may learn this trick, e.g. ['illusionist','joker'].

subclasses.description: Subclass ids that grant this trick (MECHANICS 4.9d). A trick listed here is NOT on the parent class's general list — only a character of that subclass knows it, and it is granted free on taking the subclass. If set, `classes` must still name the parent class so the trick files under the right ladder.

then.description: A Pledge is at-will: it may not carry a cooldown or an engine cost.

A Turn is always limited by a cooldown. It MAY also carry an engineCost: a costed Turn is the mid-tier payoff a caster grinds the meter for (MECHANICS 4.4a). Costed Turns are for FULL casters only - a half-caster's engine already pays for its core kit.
A Prestige spends engine, is gated to level 5+, and needs no cooldown - the engine price is its limiter.
